result.rationale: The diff verifiably inverts the condition: `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` becomes `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`. This is an exact logical negation, so orgs created with team billing disabled now get no slug (previously they did), and orgs with billing enabled now get slug directly instead of only requestedSlug. The mechanism described is fully verifiable from the diff; whether the flip was intentional (an undocumented behavior change) cannot be confirmed from the diff alone, but the described behavior change is real and would silently alter org URL/slug resolution

adjudication.rationale: In packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts the spread condition for setting `slug` is flipped from `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`. This means when `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` is false, neither `slug` nor `metadata.requestedSlug` is set (since `requestedSlug` is also gated on `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED`). Previously, non-team-billing mode set `slug` directly. The diff therefore introduces a real behavior change where orgs created without team billing enabled may end up without any slug value.
